The leaves are still green and attached (no browning or drop yet), consistent with an active mildew infection. No concentric rings (ruling out Early Blight/Target Spot), no water-soaked blotches (ruling out Late Blight), no yellow spots with velvety undersides (ruling out Leaf Mold).
